content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 — model artifact fetch failures (Hugging Face) observed across regions.

sre-oncall: I'm seeing spike in 429s hitting our model registry pull path: https://huggingface.co/api/models/<model-id>/resolve/main
logs show Retry-After headers of 30s repeatedly.

alex.k: confirming. sample from nodes:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 30
{
  "error": "rate limit exceeded",
  "retry_after": 30
}
```

maria.p: impact: cold starts for new replica launches time out, some inference requests fail when instance needs to fetch weights. Existing warm replicas OK. Estimate ~12% of requests hitting cold start path are failing.

infra-eng: rolling back recent change? No deploys in the last hour.

sre-oncall: mitigation plan:
- Apply client-side exponential backoff + jitter
- Patch model fetch to fallback to S3 cached artifacts
- Temporarily pin heavy production models to pre-pulled images or local cache
- Engage HF support and monitor their status page

sam.t: quick config snippet I pushed to staging:
```
MODEL_FETCH:
  max_retries: "8"
  backoff_factor: "2.0"
  jitter: "0.3"
```

sre-oncall: rolling the backoff config to prod now. kubectl command:
```
kubectl set env deploy/inference-service MODEL_FETCH_MAX_RETRIES=8 MODEL_FETCH_BACKOFF=2.0 -n prod
```

customer-success: which customers are impacted so we can notify? Looks like any new Dedicated warmups and on-prem onboarding runs that kick off fresh pulls.

maria.p: opened HF support ticket (https://huggingface.co/support) — ticket #HF-34218. Logged rate-limit headers and node ids. HF status page: https://status.huggingface.co/ shows intermittent 429 spikes.

infra-eng: immediate workaround: flip config to prefer local S3 cache. Patch:
```
artifact_source_priority: ["local_s3", "hf_registry"]
```
This will cause instances to pull from our S3 mirror if present.

alex.k: deploying cache-priority change to canary in us-west-2.

sre-oncall: canary looks good; cold starts now find artifacts in S3 and complete. Latency back to normal for canary pods.

sre-oncall: promoting to 50% -> 100%. Monitor token errors and 5xx.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty acknowledged incident, escalation level set to P1 oncall.

sam.t: we also pushed smaller fallback model route for web-tier (quantized smaller variant) using routing policy 'fallback-to-small-model' to reduce new fetch sizes.

customer-success: preparing customer advisory draft. Status: "Experiencing delayed cold starts due to third-party model host rate limiting. Mitigation in progress; no data exposure."

maria.p: adding postmortem trackers. Suspected root cause: upstream HF rate limiting triggered by sudden spike in model pulls (our autoscale/rolling restarts + external jobs).

sre-oncall: handoff to next oncall @alex.k in 25m. Summary for next oncall:
- HF returned 429s causing model fetch failures -> impacting cold starts
- Mitigations applied: backoff config, local S3 priority, fallback smaller model
- HF ticket #HF-34218 opened
- Monitor: model_fetch_429_rate, coldstart_fail_rate, avg_coldstart_latency

alex.k: ack. I'll take over monitoring and coordinate with infra to pre-pull models for key customers overnight.

customer-success: will draft emails to impacted customers and post incident banner on status.redwood.ai if persists.

sre-oncall: marking incident as active -> mitigated. Will update runbook and include recommended changes: pre-warm artifacts, maintain S3 mirror, rate-limit upstream fetch rates to <10 r/s per account.

maria.p: add action item: automation to prefetch top-20 models daily into S3 mirror.

alex.k: taking the handoff. thanks all. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident thread closed for update; reopen if errors recur.
